title: Kit Issue
summary: Scene 5. The stores: uniforms, and a hundred and fifty credits of kit each from Nobu's catalogue. Then Vetch inspects them and hands Section Nine a docket for the city.
goal: Each player has their uniform and kit, and Vetch has handed Section Nine the docket in person.
howToPlay: Quick and busy: Nobu runs three conversations at once, and kit takes seconds a player. **End on Vetch's docket.**

intro.where: The quartermaster's stores, after first period.
intro.readAloud: The stores smell of machine oil and stamped paper. There's no queue, only a scrum at one long counter, and behind it a young man in braces is talking to a candidate, a clipboard and somebody in the back room at once, and finishing all three conversations.
intro.landmark: The long counter, with a slate board of names behind it.

carriesIn.then: They're last in, and the handlamps have run out.

brief.wants: Forty candidates kitted by the end of the day, with nothing that matters dropped.
brief.opensWith: "Sidearm or long arm, both on the list, your money, your choice. Good. Next thing."

willDiscuss.note: Exactly what's asked: "It's on the list or it isn't. I didn't write the list."
"That one jams if you don't clean it. Take the other one."
Slate teal-grey tunic, brass buttons, an orange tab on the collar: "Your size, or near enough."

willNotDiscuss.why: Whether he's eaten, slept or has a life: "Life? I've got a clipboard."

voice.register: Harried and fast, in run-on sentences. Does the generous thing too quickly to be thanked for it.
samples: "Good bunch this year. I say that every year. Also true every year. Next."
"Shucks said you were sharp this morning. Don't make him a liar."

cast.role: Section Nine's officer, come to inspect.

brief.wants: To find something wrong with Section Nine before they've done anything.
brief.opensWith: He walks the line and finds one thing wrong with each of them.

willDiscuss.note: "It's on the docket. Read the docket."

willNotDiscuss.why: He keeps a straight face: "An instrument part. For an instrument. As discussed."

voice.register: Clipped and procedural. Never wrong in his own account.
samples: "Collar. Buttons. That's a boot, is it? Fine."
"Back to me by nineteen hundred. Not a minute after."

beats.text: Nobu <trig id="nobu-appears"/> issues the uniforms: slate teal-grey tunics with an orange tab on the collar.
Each player spends 150 credits from the stores catalogue. Press Open Equipment Locker so everyone sees the list.
beats.direction: Seconds a player, not minutes. Anyone still deciding can finish their sheet after the session.
beats.note: If someone came in last: The handlamps have run out by their turn.

beats.text: If a player asks Nobu properly for something specific, offer the check.

when.condition: someone asks Nobu for something extra

beats.note:
Do: Fit the extra to the player: a climbing kit, a comm unit, a coil of line or a handlamp. Never a second weapon.
Secret: Some of what Nobu hands out isn't Directorate stock. Write down who got what.

beats.text: If a player wants a moment with their new gear, offer the check.
Vetch <trig id="vetch-inspects"/> walks the line, finds fault with each of them, and hands Section Nine a docket. Show the table.
beats.readAloud:
He hands the docket to whoever is nearest. It reads: COMPOUND, LEVELLING, BUBBLE, ONE (1). Collect from the instrument makers. Sign here, here, and on the reverse.

"Second period first. Then the city. Back to me by nineteen hundred."
beats.note:
Plant: It's a direct order, and refusing one is the serious thing the Deputy Director warned them about.
Secret: There's no such part. Vetch sends every new section for the bubble in a spirit level. It was done to him once.

handouts.title: The stores docket
handouts.body:
特別対策本部SPECIAL COUNTERMEASURES HEADQUARTERSStores

STORES DOCKET

Section: NINE

Item: COMPOUND, LEVELLING, BUBBLE, ONE (1)

Collect from: the instrument makers

Sign here, here, and on the reverse.
handouts.gmNotes: Secret: a spirit level's bubble is the air in its vial. There's nothing to collect.
catchables: The item: a spirit level's bubble, which is the part that isn't there.
"Sign here, here, and on the reverse": the instrument makers will want it signed.

outro.endsWhen: Vetch has handed over the docket and gone.
outro.onwards: School: Second Period, with the docket in a pocket; then The Errand.
writeDown: What each player bought, and any extra Nobu gave.

temptations.text: Nobu clearly has more in the back than he's putting on the counter.

notes: The catalogue is a hundred and fifty credits of real SF2E commercial gear, reflavoured as Directorate issue; the Equipment Locker shows it to every player. Nobu's extra item is earned by asking him properly, never automatic. Vetch's docket is the start of the episode's thread with him: the bubble, the vial, the drains, and the report at the hatch.
